entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Shri Hemant Sharma, Public Prosecutor for
State.

Heard on I.A.No.27493 of 2021, which is an application for suspension of jail sentence of the applicant who has been convicted by the ASJ, Indore, vide judgment dated 16.9.2019, for the offence punishable under Sections 7(1) read with Section 16(1)(A)(1) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and has been sentenced to undergo 1 year RI with fine of Rs.1000/-.
In the order dated 16.9.2019 passed by the ASJ, Indore the aforesaid conviction and sentence has been affirmed against such order of the appeal by the appellate Court.
Hence, this revision has been filed.
Learned counsel for applicant has earlier pointed out that applicant is senior citizen and suffering from paralysis and other ailments and suspension was sought on medical grounds.
This court had called for verification report vide order dated 23.10.2021.
The verification report shows that appellant is indeed suffering from paralysis, diabetes and blood pressure and his condition is not normal.

After due consideration, on the basis of the medical report, I.A.No.27493 of 2021 is allowed and it is directed that applicant depositing the fine amount (if not already deposited) and on furnishing a personal bond to the tune of Rs.50,000/- with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court, the substantive jail sentence of the applicant shall remain suspended till the final disposal of the revision and he shall be released on bail, for his regular appearance before the Trial Court on 20.12.2021 and all other subsequent dates as may be fixed in this behalf.
MAHADEV SUKHDEVE Date: 2021.10.28 17:56:38 IST 2 CRR-5258-2019 C.c. as per rules.

(SHAILENDRA SHUKLA) JUDGE SS/-
